summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of non-dimensional coordinates being demoted to variables during the `coarsen.construct` operation. However, the change introduces a logical error.

issues.description: The line `should_be_coords = (set(window_dim) & set(self.obj.coords)) | set(self.obj.coords)` incorrectly sets all coordinates to be coordinates in the result, which may lead to unintended behavior and incorrect results.
